notes.AUS: 違法；2023 年 7 月起授權的精神科醫師可以開 psilocybin 治療難治型憂鬱症
notes.CAN: 違法但不取締；可以申請醫療用途的特別許可
notes.CHL: 違法，但少量容許、除罪化
notes.CZE: 違法但除罪化；2026 年 1 月 1 日起醫療用途合法（精神科醫院的輔助治療）
notes.GRC: 違法（依含有的 psilocin 處理）
notes.MEX: 違法，原住民文化裡的使用不取締
notes.NLD: 2008 年起禁止迷幻蘑菇，但「迷幻松露」（菌核）合法，可以買賣
notes.PHL: 條目寫合法，但法律不明確
notes.POL: 含 psilocybin 或 psilocin 的違法
notes.ESP: 違法，私人場所個人使用除罪化
notes.CHE: 違法，持有除罪化、當場罰款
notes.TWN: psilocybin（西洛西賓）是第二級毒品（毒品危害防制條例）
notes.USA: 依州、市而定：科羅拉多州合法，奧勒岡州與西雅圖、舊金山、華盛頓特區等地除罪化，聯邦違法

notesEn.AUS: Illegal; since July 2023 authorised psychiatrists may prescribe psilocybin for treatment-resistant depression
notesEn.CAN: Illegal (unenforced); special access for medical use possible
notesEn.CHL: Illegal, but tolerated and decriminalised for small amounts
notesEn.CZE: Illegal but decriminalised; medical use legal since 1 January 2026 (assisted therapy in psychiatric hospitals)
notesEn.MEX: Illegal, unenforced in native cultural use
notesEn.NLD: Magic mushrooms banned since 2008, but “magic truffles” (sclerotia) are legal to buy and sell
notesEn.PHL: Listed as legal, but the law is ambiguous
notesEn.POL: Illegal when containing psilocybin or psilocin
notesEn.ESP: Illegal; decriminalised for personal use in a private place
notesEn.CHE: Illegal; possession decriminalised and punished with a spot fine
notesEn.TWN: Psilocybin is a Schedule 2 narcotic under the Narcotics Hazard Prevention Act
notesEn.USA: Varies by state and city: legal in Colorado, decriminalised in Oregon and places such as Seattle, San Francisco and DC; illegal federally
